property_summary: The original contract guarantees that only the deployer (admin) can call setOwner so owner can only be changed when tx.origin/admin is the deployer; the mutant allows the current owner to call setOwner instead, so there exist inputs (caller = owner) where the mutant permits a setOwner call that the reference rejects.
change_summary: Change onlyAdmin's require to compare msg.sender to owner instead of admin, so only owner can call setOwner.
